headings.usage: Use for page titles, section headers, and major KPI labels.

body.usage: Use for data tables, descriptions, form inputs, and general UI text.

monospace.usage: CRITICAL: Use for all numeric data, KPIs, dashboard values, pH/MS/MO readings, and stock amounts.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import these fonts via Google Fonts in index.css. Do not use Inter or Roboto.

background.app: Radial gradient from `#1B2A24` to `#0D1411` to match the requested 'fond radial gris-vert'.

layouts.global: High-density dashboard layout. Strict grid hierarchy.
layouts.header: Sticky top bar, z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D1411]/80 border-b border-white/10. Contains Logo and Multi-site selector (Dropdown).
layouts.navigation: Tabs-based navigation (Pannes, Équipement, Stock, Analyses, Maintenance, Dashboard).
layouts.kpi_grid: Top of every screen. grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6.

surfaces_and_borders.style: The 'Technical/Grid' Look. Avoid soft rounded corners. Use rounded-sm or rounded-none for a strict, industrial command-center feel.
surfaces_and_borders.effects: No heavy drop shadows. Rely on 1px crisp borders (`border-white/10`) to separate elements. Cards should have `backdrop-blur-md` if overlaying the radial background.

components.buttons: Sharp corners (`rounded-sm`), high-contrast text. Hover states must shift background color slightly and maintain minimum 3:1 contrast.
components.tables: Dense padding (`py-2 px-3`), 1px bottom border per row (`border-white/5`), subtle hover row effect (`hover:bg-white/[0.02]`).
components.tabs: Override default Shadcn tabs. Use transparent background for tablist, border-b border-white/10. Active tab gets a bottom border (`border-emerald-500`) and brighter text.
components.charts: Recharts. Use `#10b981` (green) for positive/normal trends, `#ef4444` (red) for critical trends (e.g., breakdown costs). Hide unnecessary grid lines, use `strokeDasharray="3 3"` with low opacity (`#ffffff20`) for necessary axes.

visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalist and snappy. 0.15s ease-out transitions for hovers.
visual_enhancers.empty_states: Use subdued Phosphor Icons with monospace text 'NO_DATA_FOUND'.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react). Use weight='duotone' or 'regular' for industrial, technical feel.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text over the dark green/grey background has at least 4.5:1 ratio. Avoid dark gray text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, forms, tabs, and table rows MUST include `data-testid` attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Recharts for dashboards: `yarn add recharts`
Ensure all text is in French as requested ('Français uniquement').
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the dropdowns (multi-site selector). Use `bg-[#131C19] border border-white/10` to prevent unreadable text.
Implement the background on the main layout wrapping the entire app to maintain the radial grey-green effect.
Use Shadcn components but strip away the default Vercel-like rounded borders. Replace with `rounded-sm` or `rounded-none`.
Focus heavily on the 'Analyses Digestat' color interpretation (e.g., pH too low = red, normal = green) and 'Stock' alert thresholds (color coding).
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients, except for the explicit radial background requested.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle 1px borders, not heavy drop shadows.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
